evaluate component ranks against declared media lists and aggregate them
rerun the interface for gender, time, sport, function, and weight scenarios
handoff qualified lists to the nontechnical explanation
software: The paper supplies tables and formulas but no frozen input dataset, executable source code, environment, or complete run log.
algorithm.convergence_criteria: Finite matrix, entropy, distance, aggregation, and sweep operations terminate directly; no independent validation or uncertainty certificate is supplied.

assumptions: The retained five aspects and eighteen secondary metrics represent the intended comparison within the declared roster.
The collected records, interpolated values, AHP judgments, media rankings, time weights, and transfer mappings are sufficiently comparable for the stated exercise.

identifiability_feasibility.analysis: The hierarchy, equations, tables, ranks, flow chart, and sensitivity plots are inspectable, but the frozen data, coding decisions, media lists, calculation files, and independent validation are absent.

validation_refs: Physical page 29, text and source-rendered formula, table, recommendation, or code interface read from the local extraction.
models.computational_cost: Driven by small dense AHP matrices, candidate-by-indicator normalization, entropy calculations, media-list distance comparisons, ranking reruns, and parameter sweeps.
strengths: The paper exposes a long positive chain from metric definitions through two component models, aggregation, extensions, sensitivity, and audience communication.
Intermediate hierarchy, tables, distances, hit scores, before-and-after ranks, and sensitivity plots make the intended calculation route inspectable.
limitations: The same media hit-score benchmark is used for model evaluation and parameter selection, so the checks are not independent.
Confirmed formula, table, symbol, generalization, and reproducibility issues remain last-pass warnings only.
missing_details: Frozen coach and media datasets, retrieval dates, interpolation code, pairwise-judgment provenance, contribution coding, time-weight derivation, sport mappings, executable calculations, uncertainty analysis, and independent validation data are absent.
